interface.signature: def countVertex(N: int, edges: List[Tuple[int, int]]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of nodes N must be between 1 and 10^5.
The number of edges must be exactly N - 1, forming a valid tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two nodes within the range [1, N].

postconditions.description: The minimum number of nodes selected must be at least 1.
The minimum number of nodes selected must not exceed the total number of nodes N.

postconditions.expression: all(any(node in selected_nodes for node in edge) for edge in edges)
postconditions.description: Every edge must have at least one of its endpoints selected.
